name: just-in-time
description: LLMServingSim's defaults with just-in-time KV reservation: a request is admitted when its first chunk fits and its reservation grows block by block as tokens are computed (vLLM with scheduler_reserve_full_isl off). Preemption from the running set's tail when the cache fills.

reservation.notes: capacity reserved per block as tokens are produced; a running request can be preempted when the cache fills
